rules.description: Run must belong to the specified repository
rules.code_snippet: has, err := db.GetEngine(ctx).Where("id=? AND repo_id=?", runID, repoID).Get(&run)

rules.description: Run must be in a done state before rerun is allowed
rules.code_snippet: if !run.Status.IsDone() { return util.NewInvalidArgumentErrorf("this workflow run is not done") }

rules.description: Workflow must not be disabled for rerun
rules.code_snippet: if cfg.IsWorkflowDisabled(run.WorkflowID) { return util.NewInvalidArgumentErrorf("workflow %s is disabled", run.WorkflowID) }
if has && latestAttempt.Attempt >= setting.Actions.MaxRerunAttempts { return util.NewInvalidArgumentErrorf(...) }

rules.description: Rerun failed jobs filters to only Failure or Cancelled status
Rerun expands to include all downstream dependent jobs
rules.condition: A job's Needs contains a job in the rerun set
rules.action: Add the dependent job to the rerun set, iterate until no more found
rules.code_snippet: for _, need := range job.Needs { if rerunJobIDs.Contains(need) { found = true; rerunJobIDs.Add(job.JobID) } }

rules.description: Job must belong to the specified run for single-job rerun
rules.condition: slices.IndexFunc finds no job with matching ID
rules.code_snippet: jobIdx := slices.IndexFunc(jobs, func(job *actions_model.ActionRunJob) bool { return job.ID == jobID })
if runID <= 0 { ctx.APIError(http.StatusBadRequest, util.NewInvalidArgumentErrorf("runID must be a positive integer")) }
